content.text:
########## 1. Infra containers ##########
workspace-streamlet-1	Up 6 minutes	127.0.0.1:2510->3000/tcp
workspace-keycloak-1	Up 6 minutes (healthy)	8080/tcp, 8443/tcp, 9000/tcp
workspace-pgadmin-1	Up 6 minutes	80/tcp, 443/tcp
workspace-valhalla-1	Up 6 minutes (healthy)	8002/tcp
workspace-reverse-proxy-1	Up 7 minutes	127.0.0.1:3000->3000/tcp, 80/tcp, 127.0.0.1:3443->3443/tcp
workspace-db-1	Up 12 minutes (healthy)	127.0.0.1:5432->5432/tcp

########## 2. Backend health/readiness ##########
 [HTTP 200]
{"ready":true,"services":[{"name":"database","enabled":true,"healthy":true,"lastChecked":"2026-10-04T14:12:14.836557993+00:00","responseTimeMs":0.787937,"message":"service.status.connected"}]} [HTTP 200]

########## 3. Protected endpoint WITHOUT token ##########
{"error":"missing or malformed authorization header","code":"auth.missing_token"} [HTTP 401]

########## 4. Protected endpoint WITH valid Keycloak token ##########
token acquired length=1889
{"error":"identity provider unavailable","code":"auth.idp_unavailable"} [HTTP 503]

########## 5. Root cause: DNS resolution of issuer host ##########
getent hosts auth.localhost => NO RESOLUTION (exit 2)
curl http://auth.localhost:3000 (backend's issuer) => HTTP 000
curl exit 6
curl --resolve auth.localhost to 127.0.0.1 => HTTP 200

observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "########## 1. Infra containers ##########"
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'
echo
echo "########## 2. Backend health/readiness ##########"
curl -s -m 10 -w " [HTTP %{http_code}]\n" http://localhost:3030/api/health
curl -s -m 10 -w " [HTTP %{http_code}]\n" http://localhost:3030/api/ready
echo
echo "########## 3. Protected endpoint WITHOUT token ##########"
curl -s -m 10 -w " [HTTP %{http_code}]\n" http://localhost:3000/api/v1/regions
echo
echo "########## 4. Protected endpoint WITH valid Keycloak token ##########"
TOK=$(curl -s -m 20 -X POST "http://localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/token" -H "Host: auth.localhost" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=backend&client_secret=cVBGgWNlbwSLydLZfZMvTvmNCeiSmLGP" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).access_token))")
echo "token acquired length=${#TOK}"
curl -s -m 20 -w " [HTTP %{http_code}]\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" http://localhost:3000/api/v1/regions
echo
echo "########## 5. Root cause: DNS resolution of issuer host ##########"
echo -n "getent hosts auth.localhost => "; getent hosts auth.localhost || echo "NO RESOLUTION (exit $?)"
curl -s -m 8 -o /dev/null -w "curl http://auth.localhost:3000 (backend's issuer) => HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/certs || echo "curl exit $?"
curl -s -m 8 --resolve auth.localhost:3000:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w "curl --resolve auth.localhost to 127.0.0.1 => HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/certs
